ITEM 1 | Whole round fruit with glossy red-and-yellow skin, red blush over a yellow base, smooth waxy sheen, small stem cavity on top, about 8-9 cm across, sitting at the left of the plate against the tomatoes and rice | 180
ITEM 2 | About 6 small smooth, glossy oval pieces in deep red to dark purple-red, about 2-2.5 cm long, firm and whole, scattered around the upper right of the plate near the apple | 45
ITEM 3 | One small smooth, pale yellow-green oval piece with slight sheen, about 2.5 cm long, whole, on the right edge beside the nut pile | 6
ITEM 4 | Small bright red round to oval pieces with smooth, glossy skin, about 3-4.5 cm across, whole and firm, clustered in the center and right of the plate; the largest is roughly 4.5 cm long | 110
ITEM 5 | Cooked white rice, loose fluffy grains with a matte, slightly moist look, forming an irregular mound about 6 x 5 cm and 1.5 cm high, at the lower left of the plate beside the nuts | 60
ITEM 6 | About 20 light tan to brown oval pieces with pointed ends, matte dry surface and slight ridges, each about 2-3 cm long and 1 cm wide, scattered in a loose pile at the lower right of the plate | 30
